source: Real YouTube viewing on configured LG, capture to VPS, local Whisper and Codex Luna

before.description: Last completed visual analyses around a pre-deploy sample; different content, not a paired benchmark

failuresAndLimits: Three capture chunks were dropped; capture report has no detailed reason. No analysis skip in received chunks during this observation.
One title covers two advertisements because both occurred within the initial eight-second chunk; later continuation keeps that broad title.
An advertisement description rendered a size comparison to a two-euro coin as an impact of less than two euros. Contextualization does not ensure correct OCR/transcription interpretation.
Topic labels and descriptions are model outputs, not independently verified facts. No annotated semantic accuracy score or paired content comparison.
Per-call explicit context is bounded, but the Codex perception thread persists for up to twenty calls. This sample does not validate longer-term latency.
No new physical remote/navigation test; TV assets unchanged. A transient pending card remains until its analysis completes.
Card summary uses the latest two descriptions; it is not an exhaustive summary of the whole topic.

billing.reason: Codex subscription; no dollar charge returned by this perception path. No OpenRouter inference added.
